SELECT
    toQuarter(first_purchase) AS CalendarQuarter,
    count() AS NewCustomers
FROM (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        MIN(DateKey) AS first_purchase
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
    HAVING toYear(first_purchase) = 2007
)
GROUP BY CalendarQuarter
ORDER BY CalendarQuarter
